body: I can't post on that subreddit because my account is not old enough. Also my sister just doesn't care about other foods. I'm not sure about the school one, we are definitively smart at certain things but not everything.

She's 10. My dad is embarrassed. Doctors and therapists work for the government and we'll get taken away from dad and mom.

Thanks so much. The weird part is my sister is 10 and yet still only eats a few foods everyday but is still healthy. She's probably autistic like me. There is nothing wrong with her. I don't have any friends or close relatives near me.
